body.description: Preflight: verify the whole orchestration chain — python, gh, claude, and kb-core-ui's MCP server all connect.
body.name: doctor
body.title: Doctor

body.description: Re-index the code graph and check its integrity (dangling edges, resolution quality). No AI, no auth.
body.name: graph-sync
body.title: Graph Sync

body.description: Review an open PR's diff for breaking changes, quality, duplication, rewrites, pattern-mismatch, and cross-boundary contract mismatches. Posts a comment (or use dry-run).
body.name: pr-review
body.title: PR Review

body.description: Review a single commit's diff (same dimensions as PR review) — run after committing, before pushing.
body.name: commit-check
body.title: Commit Check

body.description: Generate test cases for a function or file, using the graph to cover real callers and edge cases. Prints tests (add 'true' to write the file).
body.name: test-writer
body.title: Test Writer

body.description: Scan the whole codebase for anomalies: possible breakages, cross-boundary contract mismatches, duplication, and rule violations (from memory).
body.name: anomaly-scan
body.title: Anomaly Detector

args.label: Feature description
args.name: feature
args.placeholder: e.g. add a REST endpoint to delete a symbol

body.description: Plan a proposed feature against this codebase: rules it might break, code to reuse, optimal options, a PRD, and tests to keep current behavior safe.
body.name: feature-verdict
body.title: Feature Verdict

body.description: Correlate a GitHub issue to the code via the graph + memory and suggest fixes with file:line references. (Intercom source planned — needs auth.)
